column1: # CODON-OPT-001 / B08 R14: characterization of CodonOptimizer.RemoveRestrictionSites and OptimizeSequence(avoidSites) before the linear rewrite.
# Generated 2026-11-02 from the code at commit ea937485 (the quadratic implementation; its behaviour was validated against DNA Chisel in B02 F54/F60) by a
# throwaway generator (System.Random seed 20261102): 320 RemoveRestrictionSites cases (EColiK12 / Yeast / Human, genetic codes 1, 2, 11, DNA or RNA spelling, lower
# case, ambiguity bases, trailing partial codons, 1-3 sites incl. IUPAC, reverse-complement duplicates, empty entries, planted occurrences), 140
# OptimizeSequence cases (MaximizeCAI / BalancedOptimization / MinimizeSecondary, GC bounds, GC windows null / 24 / 45 / 90, codes 1 and 2) and 4 refusals. The
# new implementation also reproduced 3 x 3 105 further random cases byte for byte (seeds 11, 22, 33), which are not stored.
# Columns: id, mode (R = RemoveRestrictionSites, O = OptimizeSequence with the sites as avoidSites), table, genetic code, strategy, gcMin, gcMax, gcWindow, sites
# (comma separated, <empty> = an empty entry), sequence (<empty> = ""), expected (R: the sequence; O: the optimized sequence | changed codons; !Type = that exception).
